report.title: UKSI taxa for tanhub
report.description: A list of UKSI taxa for tanhub.
report.query: -- Return all preferred, data-entry-enabled taxa in the configured groups and their accepted hierarchy. WITH all_ttlids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT cttl.id FROM cache_taxa_taxon_lists cttlc JOIN cache_taxon_paths ctp ON ctp.taxon_meaning_id=cttlc.taxon_meaning_id AND ctp.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id# JOIN cache_taxa_taxon_lists cttl ON cttl.taxon_meaning_id=ANY(ctp.path) AND cttl.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id# AND cttl.preferred=true AND cttl.allow_data_entry=true WHERE cttlc.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id# AND cttlc.allow_data_entry=true #filters# ) SELECT #columns# FROM cache_taxa_Taxon_lists cttl JOIN taxon_groups tg ON tg.id=cttl.taxon_group_id AND tg.deleted=false JOIN cache_taxon_searchterms cts on cts.taxa_taxon_list_id=cttl.id AND cts.simplified=true JOIN cache_taxon_paths ctp ON ctp.taxon_meaning_id=cttl.taxon_meaning_id AND ctp.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id# LEFT JOIN (cache_taxa_taxon_lists cttlp JOIN recording_scheme_taxa rst ON rst.organism_key=cttlp.organism_key AND rst.deleted=false JOIN recording_schemes rs ON rs.id=rst.recording_scheme_id AND rs.deleted=false ) ON cttlp.taxon_meaning_id=ANY(ctp.path) AND cttlp.preferred=true -- Aggregate before joining so designation multiplicity cannot multiply report rows. -- JSON preserves abbreviation boundaries for delimiter validation by the importer. LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ttd.taxon_id, json_agg(DISTINCT btrim(td.abbreviation) ORDER BY btrim(td.abbreviation)) FILTER (WHERE t.term='GB Red List') AS gb_red_list, json_agg(DISTINCT btrim(td.abbreviation) ORDER BY btrim(td.abbreviation)) FILTER (WHERE t.term='GB Status') AS gb_status FROM taxa_taxon_designations ttd JOIN taxon_designations td ON td.id=ttd.taxon_designation_id AND td.deleted=false JOIN cache_termlists_terms t ON t.id=td.category_id AND t.term IN ('GB Red List', 'GB Status') WHERE ttd.deleted=false AND NULLIF(btrim(td.abbreviation), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ttd.taxon_id ) designations ON designations.taxon_id=cttl.taxon_id -- Cardinality is resolved across all entries for this meaning before JSON aggregation. -- Selecting by value-row ID tolerates conflicting singleton assignments without duplicating taxa. LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT json_build_object('version', 1, 'attributes', COALESCE(json_agg( json_build_object('id', a.id, 'data_type', a.data_type, 'multi_value', a.multi_value, 'termlist_id', a.termlist_id, 'values', COALESCE(selected.values, '[]'::json)) ORDER BY a.id), '[]'::json)) AS payload FROM taxa_taxon_list_attributes a LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('value', chosen.int_value, 'label', terms.term) ORDER BY chosen.id) AS values FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (CASE WHEN a.multi_value THEN v.int_value ELSE v.id END) v.id, v.int_value FROM taxa_taxon_list_attribute_values v JOIN cache_taxa_taxon_lists entries ON entries.id=v.taxa_taxon_list_id AND entries.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id# AND entries.taxon_meaning_id=cttl.taxon_meaning_id WHERE v.taxa_taxon_list_attribute_id=a.id AND v.deleted=false ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.multi_value THEN v.int_value ELSE v.id END, v.id LIMIT CASE WHEN a.multi_value THEN NULL ELSE 1 END ) chosen LEFT JOIN cache_termlists_terms terms ON a.data_type='L' AND terms.id=chosen.int_value ) selected ON true WHERE a.deleted=false AND a.id=ANY(ARRAY[#taxon_attribute_ids#]::integer[]) ) attributes ON true WHERE cttl.id IN (SELECT id FROM all_ttlids)

param.name: taxon_list_id
param.description: ID of the taxon list to load taxa for.

param.name: reporting_taxon_ranks
param.description: Configured reporting ranks used for projection fields, quoted CSV.

param.name: taxon_group_ids
param.description: Optional taxon groups of the taxa to load, comma separated IDs.

column.name: parent_taxon_identifier
column.sql: (select parent.organism_key from cache_taxa_taxon_lists parent where parent.taxon_meaning_id=ANY(ctp.path) and parent.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id# and parent.preferred=true and parent.allow_data_entry=true and parent.taxon_rank_sort_order < cttl.taxon_rank_sort_order order by parent.taxon_rank_sort_order desc, parent.id desc limit 1)

column.name: higher_taxa
column.sql: (select json_agg(json_build_object('organism_key', ht.organism_key, 'taxon', ht.taxon, 'taxon_rank', ht.taxon_rank) order by ht.taxon_rank_sort_order, ht.id) FROM cache_taxa_taxon_lists ht WHERE ht.taxon_meaning_id=ANY(ctp.path) AND ht.preferred=true AND ht.taxon_rank IN (#reporting_taxon_ranks#) AND ht.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id#)
